crash.body: Your documents are safe. Restart the app to continue.

lock.title: Kagazzz Docs is locked
lock.subtitle: Unlock with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to continue.
lock.quick_reference_subtitle: Unlock with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to view your saved values.

root_warning.message: This device looks rooted — your documents may be less secure.

welcome.title: Welcome to Kagazzz Docs
welcome.body: Keep all your important documents safe on your phone. No account needed.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.body: Your files never leave your device. Kagazzz Docs works fully offline.

organize.title: Scan and organize
organize.body: Scan papers into clean PDFs and sort them into folders you choose.

backup.title: Locked and backed up
backup.body: Lock the app with your fingerprint, and export an encrypted backup anytime.

confirmations.delete_message: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

add.title: Add your documents
add.body: Scan paper, pick files or photos. Everything stays on this phone, encrypted.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Search by name — or by words inside your documents, like a PAN or a policy number.

ai.title: Ask your documents
ai.body: The assistant reads, finds and works on your documents — on this phone, not online.

menu.title: Everything else
menu.body: Quick reference, notes, trash, backup and settings live here.

star.title: Star a document
star.body: Tap the star on a document you use often. Starred ones are one tap away in Favorites.

lock.title: Lock the app
lock.body: Turn this on to open Kagazzz Docs with your fingerprint or face.

backup.title: Make a backup
backup.body: An encrypted backup file keeps your documents safe if this phone is lost.
